{{Article header|section=Mining|deck=Community observations of materials reported across surveyed Planetary Mining Locations.}}

'''Surface Mining Prospecting''' is a quick reference to community research from '''CMDR Grumlop''', showing where materials appeared across surveyed Planetary Mining Locations.

== Using the table ==

Each material's primary row shows the ground type with the highest observed share in the current sample. The percentages show how often that material appeared among the surveyed Planetary Mining Locations of that ground type. For example, 29.8% means it was found at 34 of 114 surveyed locations in that sample.

These figures are observations from the collected sample, not official Frontier-published spawn or drop rates. A ground type not appearing in the dataset was not recorded in this research; that absence does not prove the material can never occur there. Expand '''View other observations''' beside a material to see its other recorded ground types.
